title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：ring　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ring 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the grandmother ① wore the ring that no child in the courtyard would have measured, and he said the wearing was the whole of the year. The ② ring, meaning the band itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; a ring, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ ring in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ ring at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A ring, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the grandmother said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the ring was the whole of the matter, meaning the promise and not the band. The ⑥ ring, meaning the promise and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; ring, he said, is either something you wear or the only word that means both a band and a promise. He said the promise is the part they remember.

By 1997 the ⑦ ring had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ ring of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of measuring; ring, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ ring I remember is the band measured in the diary, which closed in 1999 and is still measured as the quietest in the courtyard. A ⑩ ring, my mother said in 2001, is the only band that improves by being measured; every ring, she said, is a promise that has agreed to look like a band. She said the promise was the honest half.

answers.why: wear the ring 意为“戴这一枚戒指”，1992 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯测量的一枚戒指做了一遍。
ring 意为“戒指；环”，指那枚戒指本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被测量。
ring 意为“戒指；环”，指院子里每一枚旁边的那一枚，每一枚旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
ring 意为“戒指；环”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
ring 意为“戒指、誓约”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这枚誓约就是那件事的全部。
ring 意为“誓约”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那枚戒指，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
ring 意为“戒指；环”，指日记里写到、被测量的那一枚，到 1997 年这一枚成了日记里的一行。
ring 意为“戒指之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的戒指之事是一处院子和三个年头的测量。
ring 意为“戒指；环”，我记得的是日记里测量过的那一枚，1999 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一枚。
ring 为抽象总称，母亲 2001 年说，戒指是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的戒指。
